cell_type.evidence: keywords: Human s26 proteasome; Crosslinking mass spectrometry

disease_state.evidence: inferred: Purified human 26S proteasome (40 ug, 0.8 μg/μL, Proteasome Pprotein Ccenter, Kibutz Ranat Yohana) was cross-linked with isotopically labeled bis(sulfosuccinimidyl) suberate d0/d12 (BS3-H12/D12, Creativemolecules Inc.) at a molar ratio of 1:10, 1:2, 1:1, 2:1, 5:1 and 10:1 crosslinker to lysines for 45 min at 25 °C while shaking at 650 rpm in a Thermomixer (Eppendorf).
